positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with engineers across the JIT and Data Guardian teams to design and implement data contracts and JIT service integrations with key Data Guardian systems, including Production Touch Ledger, Data Guardian Session Service, and Data Guardian Routing Service, strengthening Microsoft’s privacy and data governance capabilities across Europe. 
- Modernized core JIT service infrastructure by migrating from a deprecated Kusto cluster to a new cluster and from AAD Graph to Microsoft Graph, improving performance, maintainability, and long-term platform compatibility.
- Enhanced JIT service security and operational efficiency by integrating Identity Organization’s auto-rotating secret and CosmosDB CRUD platforms, eliminating manual credential rotation and reducing direct database access and manual DB operations. 
- Conducted security analysis of the JIT service to identify architectural and operational vulnerabilities, and presented findings and mitigation recommendations at the Identity organization’s annual premortem and threat review forum.
- Enhanced the JIT RDP flow by collaborating with cross-team engineers to support diverse computer node configurations, implementing TIP vs. non-TIP node identification and updating service endpoints to meet node-specific environment requirements.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented REST APIs for appraisal information and channel management in a Spring Boot microservice, supporting thousands of requests per day.  
- Built a Kafka-based messaging solution for policy renewal notifications, improving reliability and helping reduce regulatory fines associated with notification processes.  
- Designed and implemented a new field appraisal scheduling REST service to replace a legacy system, eliminating reliance on costly IBM proprietary software and reducing operational overhead. 
- Re-engineered applications to migrate from on-premises Cloudant to AWS DynamoDB, reducing infrastructure and operational costs while modernizing the data layer. 
- Designed and implemented a rental eligibility REST API that prevented premature rental scheduling for customers, reducing unnecessary rental costs.

projects.title: RentTo
projects.description:
Worked as a lead developer on creating a renting mobile app that generate passive income for users 
Effectively carried out agile methodology of development with consistent two weeks sprints and daily stand-ups
Trained other developers to up their skills in android development
